Titles.eng: Mobile Suit Gundam AGE: Memory of Eden
Titles.jpn: 機動戦士ガンダムAGE MEMORY OF EDEN

Summaries.eng: Two fates that never should have crossed paths... Asemu Asuno, son of the Earth Federation Forces commander Flit Asuno. Zeheart Galette, a warrior who throws himself into battle for the sake of the Vagan people. For a brief while they spent time together, formed a friendship, and sometimes quarreled, even as they looked up at the same cosmos. But the time has come for a bitter parting.
